title: BUDGET AND FINANCE COMMITTEE REPORT and RESOLUTION relative to the Proposition (Prop) 64 Cohort 4 Grant award from the California Board of State and…
text:
[Council File 26-1286]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
BUDGET AND FINANCE COMMITTEE REPORT and RESOLUTION relative to the Proposition (Prop) 64 Cohort 4 Grant award from the California Board of State and Community Corrections (BSCC) for the Angeles National Forest (ANF) Hazardous Fuel Reduction, Habitat Restoration and Reforestation Project.
Recommendations for Council action, SUBJECT TO THE APPROVAL OF THE MAYOR:
1. NOTE and FILE the Mayor’s Office of Economic Opportunity report dated September 4, 2026, attached to the Council file.
2. AUTHORIZE the Mayor, or designee, to:
a. Accept the Prop 64 Cohort 4 grant award in the amount of $6,000,000 from the BSCC for the performance period from July 1, 2026 through December 31, 2031 to implement the ANF Hazardous Fuel Reduction, Habitat Restoration and Reforestation Project (ANF Project).
b. Execute the grant agreement and submit any other necessary grant agreements and documents relative to the grant award, subject to the review and approval of the City Attorney as to form and legality.
c. Negotiate and execute a contract with TreePeople for a term within the grant performance period from July 1, 2026 through December 31, 2031 in a total amount not to exceed $1,607,068 to implement the ANF Project, subject to the review and approval of the City Attorney as to form and legality, compliance with City’s contracting requirements, and the availability of funds.
d. Negotiate and execute a contract with North East Trees for a term within the grant performance period from July 1, 2026 through December 31, 2031 in a total amount not to exceed $2,204,816 to implement the ANF Project, subject to the review and approval of the City Attorney as to form and legality, and compliance with the City’s contracting requirements.
e. Negotiate and execute a sole-source contract with the RAND Corporation to provide data evaluation services for the ANF Project, for a term within the grant performance period from July 1, 2026, through December 31, 2031, in a total amount not to exceed $300,000, subject to the review and approval of the City Attorney as to form and legality, and compliance with City’s contracting requirements.
3. ADOPT the Governing Body RESOLUTION, included as Attachment A of said Mayor report, which endorses the grant agreements and agrees to comply with the program and funding requirements of the grant.
4. APPROVE the funding allocation of the Prop 64 Cohort 4 grant award in the total amount of $6,000,000 for the period from July 1, 2026 through December 31, 2031, as follows:
a. Salaries and Benefits: $1,111,956
b. Service Provider Contracts: $3,811,884
c. Evaluation/Data Collection: $300,000
d. Indirect Costs: $726,679
e. Supplies, Training, and Travel: $49,481
5. REQUEST the Controller to:
a. Establish a new interest-bearing fund entitled “Proposition 64 Board of State and Community Corrections (Prop 64 BSCC) Cohort 4 Grant Fund” No. XXX/46, for the receipt and disbursement of Prop 64 Cohort 4 grant funds, to be administered by the Mayor’s Office.
b. Establish new appropriation accounts within the Prop 64 BSCC Cohort 4 Grant Fund No. XXX, in the total amount of $6,000,000, as follows:
i. Account No. 46E946, Grant Management and Administration: $4,888,044.00 ii. Account No. 46E146, Mayor: $722,800.30 iii. Account No. 46C299, Related Costs: $389,155.70
c. Increase appropriations in the amount of $722,800.30 within the Mayor’s Fund No. 100/46, Account No. 001020, Grant Reimbursed, for the reimbursement of grant-funded salary costs.
d. Transfer up to $389,155.70 from the Prop 64 BSCC Grant Fund No. XXX/46, Account No. 46E299, Related Costs, to the Mayor’s Fund No. 100/46, Revenue Source Code 5346, for the reimbursement of grant-funded fringe benefits.
6. AUTHORIZE the Mayor, or designee, to prepare Controller instructions and/or make technical adjustments as necessary to implement the actions approved by the Mayor and the City Council, subject to the approval of the City Administrative Officer (CAO); and, REQUEST the Controller to implement the instructions
Fiscal Impact Statement:
The CAO reports that the proposed grant activities, including partial salary costs of two positions in the Mayor’s Office, will be funded by the Prop 64 Cohort 4 Grant. There is no match requirement associated with the grant. There is no additional impact to the General Fund.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
(Public Works Committee waived consideration of this matter)
TIME LIMIT FILE - NOVEMBER 3, 2026
